column2: Why does a combination of fatigue, rash, a positive antibody and a raised inflammatory marker not by itself establish an autoimmune syndrome?
column3: Each is common and they need not share one mechanism; a convincing syndrome links specific features to objective tissue injury, a plausible immune pathway and a compatible time course while testing alternatives.
